display.title: Episode 547: King Shlomo and the Three Loaves of Bread (Parshas Vayeira)
display.summary_short: Avraham Avinu's readiness to do Hashem's will at the Akeidah, Shema with four brothers in Studio 604, and King Shlomo solves the mystery of an old woman's lost loaf of bread.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week of Parshas Vayeira 5753. Uncle Yossi explains that we do mitzvos because they are Hashem's will, a feeling handed down from Avraham Avinu, who rose early to fulfil Hashem's command at the Akeidah of Yitzchak; we too should learn Torah to know what Hashem wants and make Avraham proud of us. After the Hakochainik march, four brothers from one family lead the Shema, everyone gives tzedakah, and the children say Tehillim for the Rebbe's recovery. Story time: an old woman comes to King Shlomo upset. She gave two of her three fresh loaves to starving beggars, and then the wind blew the third one out to sea. Shlomo tells her that Hashem's ways are always for the good, even when we cannot see it. Soon a foreign king arrives: his leaking ship was saved when a loaf of bread plugged the hole, and he had vowed half his wealth to charity. Shlomo has the woman bake an identical loaf, and the fortune goes to her. The show closes with news that the program has moved to Sunday evenings.
display.lesson: Whatever Hashem does is for the good, even when we cannot understand it yet; trust Him and be patient.
